releases.notes:
## LunaBlur 1.0.0

First public release of LunaBlur for Fabric on Minecraft `1.21.11`.

### Features
- Lightweight frame-blended motion blur
- Cloth Config settings screen
- `/lunablur` opens the config menu
- `/lunablur <0-100>` sets blur strength directly
- Keybind to open the config menu
- Keybind to toggle blur on and off
- Optional Mod Menu integration

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader `0.18.1+`
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config
- Minecraft `1.21.11`

### Notes
- Client-side only
- Mod Menu is optional
